ContractRef.description:
Schema and behavior are separate exact-match compatibility identities.
Matching JSON field types or a package SemVer is not behavioral compatibility.

PluginIdentity.description: Claimed package identity; a host must authenticate the actual package source.

PluginTextReviewRequest.description: Exact Resource/environment choice, without an execution grant.

ProviderSelectionBinding.description:
A fixed package/contribution choice, independent of any active instance.
Its digest is supplied by the trusted package owner; this value neither
authenticates those bytes nor grants permission to load or call them.

requests.title: Requests
requests.$comment: Generated by pnpm generate:contracts from Rust/Serde. Do not edit.

CapabilityBinding.description:
Captured declaration data for one selected capability. Requested permissions
remain declarations; validation does not establish an active provider, a
grant, current authority or permission to adopt a result.

CapabilityLimits.description: Requested upper bounds. The host must also enforce its own current limits.

CapabilityToolBinding.description:
A fixed selection, not an execution grant or a trusted model instruction.
Deserialized claims must be rebound against the actual captured package.

CapabilityToolDeclaration.description:
A package-local adapter to one declared, read-only capability. Input/output
contracts, limits and permissions are taken from that capability, rather
than repeated in a model-specific descriptor. A profile is an exact choice.

query.description:
Optional bounded semantic text-query presentation. It grants no access
beyond the original capability and remains untrusted package data.

entrypoint.description: Package-relative file. Actual opening and isolation are host responsibilities.

ConflictEvidence.description: Values compared at the rejecting boundary, without user text or credentials.

ContractRef.description:
Schema and behavior are separate exact-match compatibility identities.
Matching JSON field types or a package SemVer is not behavioral compatibility.

componentId.description: Exactly one component owns activation and cleanup of this contribution.

EffectKind.description:
Read-only concerns project state; proposals are not already-adopted changes.
Network/process effects still require their own host authorization.

ExecutionEnvironmentDescriptor.description:
Fixed execution choices for the two actual runtime profiles. Each variant
has a strict, distinct profile value and its own data/hash owner. Captured
Node serialization and digests remain exactly those of its existing type.

NativeHostEnvironmentDescriptor.description:
The native executable and its package resources are already fixed by the
separate provider binding. Native execution has no Node/tool/bootstrap tree.
This profile instead records the actual application Host executable identity.

NativeHostExecutableIdentity.description:
Identity of the actual application Host executable. This neither identifies
a publisher nor captures operating-system libraries or dynamically loaded
images. It must come from the trusted Host's OS observation, not a worker.

PermissionRequest.description: These are requested permissions, never an authorization token.

PluginIdentity.description: Claimed package identity; a host must authenticate the actual package source.

PluginInventoryView.description:
Installation and approval remain separate even when only one exists. These
are metadata observations; Sealed and enabled are not runnable assertions.

PluginNativeHostOfferView.description: Current application observation, independent of an installation or approval.

PluginTextReviewListEntry.description:
A missing environment is an observed unavailable Resource, never a synthetic
digest or a selectable request. An existing selection keeps its exact digest.

PluginUninstallView.description:
An observation of the original retained removal journal. Sealed metadata is
not confirmation of an uncertain command's filesystem durability.

ProviderSelection.description:
Multiple providers retain separate provenance. A later merge is another
explicitly selected capability, not registration-order precedence.

ProviderSelectionBinding.description:
A fixed package/contribution choice, independent of any active instance.
Its digest is supplied by the trusted package owner; this value neither
authenticates those bytes nor grants permission to load or call them.

RecoveryGuidance.description: A read or user decision to make before another mutation; never replay authority.

ReviewRuleDeclaration.description:
A rule may permit N/A only for a captured scope with no selected translation.
Source-only rules must still run for a source fallback. Domain findings in
this contract are mandatory and cannot acquire ordinary issue waivers.

treeDigest.description:
Digest of every actual file and its executable flag, including metadata,
dependencies and licenses; this is not the entrypoint's file digest.

RuntimeEnvironmentDescriptor.description:
Exact tool and Host choices for a fixed invocation. Paths are logical within
their respective artifacts, never machine paths. The trusted installer owns
approval of these bytes and the tool version, independently of worker output.
A digest is derived from the whole validated value, not separately supplied.

RuntimeEnvironmentProfile.description:
The installer must independently verify that the approved tool distribution
depends only on the supported platform's system libraries. The profile does
not describe arbitrary Homebrew/npm installations, a sandbox or a captured
OS image. Runtime capture must refuse unsupported profiles and platforms.

SourceImportDeclaration.description:
All listed materials are required, relative to one user-selected directory.
This first contract supports fixed files, not globs or discovery programs.

reviewResource.description: Exact immutable Resource whose domain rules are adopted with this source.

SourceRevisionPolicy.description:
Captured by the trusted policy owner before a proposal is received. Only
these exact block schemas contribute opaque bytes to source revisions.

TextReviewDeclaration.description:
One provider's available rules. An invocation must use an explicitly chosen
nonempty subset; installation and a matching spelling do not select rules.

TextReviewDisposition.description:
Selecting a check is not adopting its resource or requiring its findings.
Blocking checks continue to use the original mandatory Review contract.

TextReviewResourceBinding.description:
A declared Resource contribution in the exact same package as the checker.
This mirrors Resource metadata, without coupling review to tool declarations.

TextReviewResourcePin.description:
Exact package Resource bytes captured by the Host, never a plugin's mutable
lookup or a claim that the referenced resource has been adopted by a project.

selections.description: Explicit senses or categories. Matching text alone does not select them.

target.description: One explicit target option; no host-side locale or value normalization.

TranslationMaterialDeclaration.description:
Metadata describing one selected file relative to an explicitly granted
directory. No glob, executable discovery or filesystem authority is implied.
